name: pintag-listing-map-placement-tests
description: Proves the property map (Google Maps embed + Open in Google Maps + Nearby Places, all previously the third .detail-grid column far down the page) now renders directly under the title on listing.html -- on both desktop and mobile -- and that everything about it besides its position (coordinates/marker, tracking, localization, unit-selection re-render, responsive sizing, CSP) is unchanged.
